d: FRIENDS! Fourth bonus episode of Farzi Mushaira is here! Sulagna Panigrahi joins the gang of farzi shayars i.e. Zakir Khan, Tanmay Bhat, Nishant Tanwar and of course, Gopal Datt. In this episode of delicate yet pain filled shayaris, matters like peak of drinking times, fake profiles and dad's exes, hiding of secrets and ignorance by crushes and fathers discovering romantic messages are discussed.
